Implementation Plan

## Plan for issue #10221: stop failure-path steps from running scripts committed in the PR

Planning ref is `ai/issue-10166` at `dfae22fd7495d497552dcfed040e18f2fc6a056a`. `Integration branch mismatch: false`.

The finding is confirmed in the code, and it reaches further than the three cited steps. In `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, the `codex-agent` job has 36 two-line wrappers. Each tries `${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR:-}/<script>` first, then falls back to `${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.codex-workflow-src/scripts/<script>` with no check.

- **The fallback directory can hold PR files.** "Checkout repo" (line 2332) checks out the PR head into the workspace with `GH_PAT`, so a PR can commit its own `.codex-workflow-src/scripts/...` files.
- **An early failure keeps them.** If any step before "Checkout workflow support source" (line 2420) fails, the PR's copy is never replaced. That includes "Reject project OpenCode configuration before agent setup" (line 2371) when the PR adds `.opencode`, the safe-path Python check, the git auth step and "Resolve workflow support ref". Staging (line 2438) also never runs, so `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` stays unset.
- **Steps that run after the failure load the PR's copy with secrets.** These are:
  - "Assemble failure evidence" (line 5461, `always() && failure()`)
  - "Mark linked issues review-blocked (workflow failure)" (line 5522, `failure()`)
  - "Post review-blocked comment on PR (workflow failure)" (line 5571, `failure()`)
  - Three `!cancelled()` steps whose other conditions are all `env.X != 'true'` tests, which pass when the variables are unset. Not all three are certain to carry the secrets (see the conflict note below):
    - "Post editor summary comment" (line 4148)
    - "Detect editor-claimed-but-uncommitted changes" (line 4224)
    - "Validate editor no-op disposition" (line 4279)

  The failure-path steps load the script with `source` while `GH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}` and `AI_COMMENT_SIGNING_SECRET` are set. The other `always()` wrappers (lines 2675, 3938, 4168, 5143, 5484, 5506, 5680, 5740) have the same flaw but cannot run at that point today, because their conditions depend on variables that are only set later.
- **Normal runs never need the fallback.** `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh` exits 1 when any `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` entry is missing (lines 102–108). `test_step_scripts_are_required_bootstrap_scripts` requires every registered step script to be in that list. So when staging succeeded, the staged copy always exists. The fallback only matters when staging did not complete, which is exactly the unsafe case.

**Conflict notes:**
- `agents.md` "Workflow file size limit" says the wrapper also tries `.codex-workflow-src-main/scripts`. No wrapper in `review_autofix.yml` has that third path, and the contract test pins exactly two resolution lines.
- The issue's exploit text describes the three cited steps. The three `!cancelled()` steps above are additional reachable sites found while planning. I confirmed `GH_TOKEN` only for the cited failure-path steps; the implementer should check the `!cancelled()` steps' `env:` blocks. The fix covers every wrapper either way.

## Functions or modules to implement

**1. Mark the support checkout as verified.** In `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, step "Ensure workflow support source checkout" (about line 2429), add one line after the existing `rev-parse HEAD != SCRIPT_REF` check (which exits 1 on mismatch):

`echo "WORKFLOW_SUPPORT_SOURCE_VERIFIED=true" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"`

This step runs only after "Checkout workflow support source" has succeeded and replaced the directory, and the HEAD check above it passed. So the flag is never set when an earlier step failed, and never set for a checkout that came from the PR. This follows the same idea as the gate job's `HEAD_GATE_HELPER_VERIFIED`.

**2. Gate the fallback in all 36 wrappers.** In the same file, change line 2 of every generic wrapper in the `codex-agent` job (all 36 lines matching `|| REVIEW_AUTOFIX_STEP_SCRIPT="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.codex-workflow-src/scripts/<script>"`) to:

`[ -f "${REVIEW_AUTOFIX_STEP_SCRIPT}" ] || [ "${WORKFLOW_SUPPORT_SOURCE_VERIFIED:-false}" != "true" ] || [ "$(git -C "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.codex-workflow-src" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" != "${SCRIPT_REF:-unset}" ] || REVIEW_AUTOFIX_STEP_SCRIPT="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.codex-workflow-src/scripts/<script>"`

- The last command in the `||` chain is a plain assignment. That keeps the default `bash -e` step shell from exiting on a failed `[ ]` test.
- When the flag is unset, or HEAD does not match, the script path stays at `${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR:-}/<script>`. That file does not exist, so the unchanged `if [ ! -f ... ]` block runs: `::error::` and `exit 1` for error steps, `::warning::` and `exit 0` for `always()` steps. Nothing from the PR is ever loaded.
- `${SCRIPT_REF:-unset}` makes sure a failing `git` call (empty output) never matches an empty `SCRIPT_REF`.
- Lines 1 and 3–6 of each wrapper, and every step's `name:`, `id:`, `if:`, `env:` and `continue-on-error:`, stay as they are.
- Make the edit with a small, checked script, not a regex in place. Afterwards confirm that 36 gated lines exist and that no ungated line is left.

**3. Leave the other jobs alone.** `post-merge-validate-dispatch`, `post-merge-force-poll` and `fingerprint-cap-block` (lines 863–1901) never check out the PR into the workspace root. They read only the `.codex-workflow-src` checkout pinned to `review_support_sha`. `deterministic-skip-merge` keeps the PR in `.codex-skip-pr-head`.

**4. Tests**, in `tests/test_review_autofix_step_scripts_contract.py`:
- Update `expected_lines[1]` in `test_moved_steps_run_only_the_resolving_wrapper` to the gated line. This test fails on the base commit.
- Add `test_workspace_fallback_requires_verified_support_checkout`. It fails on the base commit. It checks that:
  - "Ensure workflow support source checkout" runs the HEAD-vs-`SCRIPT_REF` check before the `WORKFLOW_SUPPORT_SOURCE_VERIFIED=true` line.
  - In the `codex-agent` steps, "Checkout workflow support source" comes before "Ensure workflow support source checkout", which comes before "Stage workflow support files".
  - Every line in the raw workflow that assigns `REVIEW_AUTOFIX_STEP_SCRIPT` to `.codex-workflow-src` contains both the flag test and the `rev-parse HEAD` / `SCRIPT_REF:-unset` test.
  - The three cited steps, "Assemble failure evidence", "Mark linked issues review-blocked (workflow failure)" and "Post review-blocked comment on PR (workflow failure)", are named explicitly.
- Add a behaviour test that runs the real wrapper text from "Mark linked issues review-blocked (workflow failure)" and "Assemble failure evidence" under `bash -e`. It uses a temporary `GITHUB_WORKSPACE` with a planted `.codex-workflow-src/scripts/<script>` that writes a marker file, and `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` unset.
  - Flag unset: no marker, exit 1 for the error step, exit 0 for the warning step.
  - Flag `true` but the directory is not a git repo, or HEAD does not match: no marker.
  - Flag `true`, a git repo whose HEAD equals `SCRIPT_REF`: the marker is written. Set this repo up following agents.md "Test-suite git environment isolation" (L3080), with git config and environment isolated.

**5. Docs.** Add the fragment `agents.d/10221-review-wrapper-verified-fallback.md`, with marker `<!-- agents: section="Workflow file size limit" -->`. It records three rules:
- The `codex-agent` wrapper falls back to `.codex-workflow-src` only when `WORKFLOW_SUPPORT_SOURCE_VERIFIED=true`, which "Ensure workflow support source checkout" sets, and HEAD equals `SCRIPT_REF`.
- New wrappers must use the gated line.
- An `always()`, `failure()` or `!cancelled()` step can never load a PR-tree copy.

Also add `changelog.d/10221-review-wrapper-verified-fallback.md`, following the existing `changelog.d` fragment format.

## Data structures affected
- One new job-level environment variable written through `GITHUB_ENV`: `WORKFLOW_SUPPORT_SOURCE_VERIFIED`. It is unset by default, and the wrappers read it as `${WORKFLOW_SUPPORT_SOURCE_VERIFIED:-false}`. A repo-wide search found no existing identifier with this name.
- No change to workflow inputs, outputs, secrets, labels or log prefixes.

## API or interface changes
- None outside the workflow.
- Inside the job, the fallback now runs only from the verified checkout. Normal runs behave exactly as before, because the staged copy always exists once staging succeeds.
- A run that fails before or during the verified support checkout behaves differently: failure-path wrappers skip (warning steps) or fail with `::error::` (error steps), instead of loading the PR's copy.
- A run where support staging itself fails after the HEAD check still falls back to the verified checkout, as before.

Data flow:
1. "Checkout repo" puts the PR tree in the workspace; it may contain `.codex-workflow-src/`.
2. Then either:
   - An early step fails. The flag is never set, so every wrapper that still runs skips or fails without loading anything.
   - Or "Checkout workflow support source" cleans and replaces `.codex-workflow-src`, and "Ensure workflow support source checkout" checks HEAD against `SCRIPT_REF` and sets the flag.
